lifetime.primaryClock: Each command_start is captured before stage/start/raw/launch work and passed as command_start+180; no reset after spawn.
lifetime.cleanupSubset: Captured terminate/reap duration is separately summed within the elapsed command phase. Unknown cleanup is null rather than fabricated0.
lifetime.tracker: Registered before primary start-record persistence; spawnAttempted set before Popen; captured PID copied on ordinary path and recovered from child in protected finalization. The actual record stays referenced even if final receipt writing raises.
lifetime.primaryUnreached: Means no primary invocation tracker, not merely no returned receipt.
lifetime.receiptFailure: primaryInvocationsWithoutFinalReceipt and primaryFinalizationComplete distinguish missing finalization. Every failing caller finally retains actual elapsed command duration and tracker cleanup data.
lifetime.captureBoundary: All known tracker PIDs are examined at final cleanup; an attempted launch without a captured PID produces unknownPrimaryLaunches and capturedSessionMembersAfter=null.
lifetime.cleanupLimits: Only captured session/group members and newly observed TEST-prefixed task temps are covered; no universal escaped-process, native custody, or global temporary-files proof.
lifetime.terminalCutoff: Managed signals are blocked, handler-collected and pending signals are reconciled at the explicit cutoff, the first successful final receipt is written under the mask, then handlers and mask are restored. Later signals remain outside the receipt guarantee.
lifetime.outerExit: Independent observed actual supervisor exit0 is required for any continuation, in addition to the complete inner evidence. This static review contains no such execution.
